_instructions.howToUpdate: Edit only this file. The dashboard (public/dashboard.html) reads it automatically on load.
_instructions.ragValues: Use exactly: GREEN | AMBER | RED | HOLD (case-insensitive). Applied to rag.schedule, rag.budget, rag.scope, rag.quality, and rag.overall. GREEN=On Track, AMBER=At Risk, RED=Off Track, HOLD=On Hold. HOLD projects are excluded from the global RAG calculation.
_instructions.ragOverallVsScheduleStatus: These are TWO DIFFERENT fields controlling TWO DIFFERENT columns. rag.overall = the coloured dot in the Overall RAG column; it also drives the global portfolio health indicator and all pulse counts. scheduleStatus = the text pill in the Schedule column (shown alongside scheduleVariance, e.g. '+2d AT RISK'). A project can be AT RISK on schedule yet GREEN overall if budget and scope are healthy — so both fields must be set independently.
_instructions.scheduleStatusValues: Use exactly: ON TRACK | AT RISK | DELAYED | ON HOLD. Controls only the Schedule column pill — does NOT affect global RAG or pulse counts.
_instructions.phaseValues: Use exactly: DISCOVER | PREPARE | EXPLORE | REALIZE | DEPLOY | RUN (case-insensitive)
_instructions.subPhaseValues: DISCOVER: 'Solution exploration' | 'Trial & prototyping' | 'Value & roadmap definition'. PREPARE: 'Project initiation' | 'Team enablement' | 'System provisioning' | 'Scoping & planning'. EXPLORE: 'Fit-to-standard workshops' | 'Fit-gap analysis' | 'Requirements gathering'. REALIZE: 'Solution configuration' | 'Development & extensions' | 'Sprint cycles' | 'Testing (SIT/UAT)' | 'Data migration setup'. DEPLOY: 'Cutover planning' | 'Dress rehearsals' | 'End-user training' | 'Go-live execution'. RUN: 'Hypercare support' | 'System monitoring' | 'Continuous improvement'
_instructions.projectStatusNote: OPTIONAL — do not add this field unless a project is complete. When omitted, the dashboard auto-infers the status: rag.overall=HOLD → shown as On Hold; everything else → active. The only value you ever need to set manually is 'complete', which dims the row and scorecard card to indicate the project has finished.
_instructions.milestoneTypeValues: Use exactly: REVIEW | GO/NO-GO | MILESTONE | APPROVAL | DECISION
_instructions.riskLevelValues: Use exactly: HIGH | MED | LOW | DEP | ESC | WATCH
_instructions.decisionProjectId: Each decision MUST have a projectId matching the id of one of the projects in the projects array. This links the ask to its project and displays a project tag on the dashboard.
_instructions.IMPORTANT: The dashboard AUTO-COMPUTES the global RAG, summary counts, and portfolio health from rag.overall on each project — not from scheduleStatus. You only need to manually set keyFlag in the pulse section, and projectId on each decision.
